# SSpinner `<s-spinner>`

```ts
import { SSpinner } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Example

<script setup>
import SSpinnerDemo from '../examples/demos/SSpinnerDemo.vue'
</script>

<div class="demo-surface">

<SSpinnerDemo />

</div>

```vue
<script setup>
import { SSpinner } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <SSpinner accessibilityLabel="Loading, small" size="base" />
  <SSpinner accessibilityLabel="Loading, large" size="large" />
  <SSpinner accessibilityLabel="Loading, extra large" size="large-100" />
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | A label that describes the purpose of the progress. When set, it will be announced to users using assistive technologies and will provide them with more context. Providing an `accessibilityLabel` is recommended if there is no accompanying text describing that something is loading. |
| `size` | `"base" \| "large" \| "large-100"` |  |
